description: State Grid and university researchers publish classified lightning electric-field waveforms in very-low- to medium-frequency bands. Four folders separate 15,290 cloud-to-ground events, 3,946 preliminary-breakdown events, 3,919 narrow bipolar pulses and 4,111 general intracloud events. ScienceDB describes paired CSV waveform and PNG image files and applies CC BY-NC 4.0 for free non-commercial reuse. The describing article locates thirteen instruments in Hefei and its surroundings, with observations from March to October during 2022–2023. The signals can validate lightning classification used in power-system hazard monitoring and resilience simulations. These labelled examples are not an unbiased lightning-frequency climatology and do not directly specify equipment damage probabilities. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
name: VLF to MF Band Classified Lightning Electric Field Change Waveform Dataset
